Datatable.LocalizationPair: Builder of Wonders

It requires a relentless drive for improvement and creation to mold the planets and star systems into a thriving empire full of wealth and opportunity. Only by relentlessly building and developing can a dream for galactic greatness be achieved.
Have $ImprovementAmount Unique Star System Improvements in your Empire.
Every empire that achieves this completes the Deed and receives all of its rewards.
Congratulations! You have achieved this Legendary Deed! Other empires can no longer hope to obtain it.
Another empire has achieved this Legendary Deed. You are no longer able to achieve it.
Creator of Wealth

To some, Dust is a miraculous substance coveted for its power as much as for its trade value. To others, Dust is merely a way of keeping score and seeing who is ahead in the great game of political domination. Regardless of how you may feel, it is time to show the riches you are able to produce!
Produce $DustAmount Dust in a single star system.
Every empire that achieves this completes the Deed and receives all of its rewards.

Architect of Industries
